from sympy import MatrixSymbol, ZeroMatrix
from sympy.matrices.expressions.blockmatrix import BlockMatrix
from sympy.matrices.expressions.blockmatrix import block_collapse

a = MatrixSymbol('a', 2, 2)
z = ZeroMatrix(2, 2)
b = BlockMatrix([[a, z], [z, z]])

print('b:', b)
print('b*b block_collapse:', block_collapse(b*b))
print('b._blockmul(b):', b._blockmul(b))
print('types:', type(b._blockmul(b).blocks[0,1]))
print('b*b*b block_collapse:', block_collapse(b*b*b))
print('done')
